newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were little changed in quiet trade on Monday morning.
Traders said firmer crude was supportive but the tone was generally soft with very little buying interest seen.

Offers for pipeline spec were pegged around $186. A cargo was traded on Friday at $186.50 cif Antwerp after similar material made $192 earlier in the week. Russian cargoes were thought still available at around $182.
Good fob avails of most grades were seen keeping buyers relaxed. Bids were assessed around $4-$6 under the cargo offers depending on quality.
